column2: The submarine mapped a deep ocean trench where two tectonic plates meet.
column3: 潛水艇繪製了兩塊板塊交會處的深海海溝。
column5: trench 像海底被大湯匙挖出一條又窄又長的深溝

column2: Hikers followed the narrow ridge to the summit, with steep slopes falling away on both sides.
column3: 登山客沿著狹窄的山脊走向山頂，兩側都是陡坡。
column5: ridge 諧音「瑞吉」，想像貓咪沿著屋頂的脊線散步

column2: A widening rift in East Africa may one day split the continent into two landmasses.
column3: 東非不斷擴大的裂谷，有一天可能把大陸分成兩塊陸地。
column5: rift 像 gift 的 g 換成 r，禮物盒被撕開一道裂縫

column2: Fossils are usually found in sedimentary rock, which forms when layers of mud and sand are pressed together.
column3: 化石通常出現在沉積岩中，它由層層泥沙壓實而成。
column5: sediment 沉澱物 + ary，一層層疊起來像千層蛋糕

column2: Intense heat and pressure deep underground turned the limestone into metamorphic marble.
column3: 地底深處的高溫與壓力把石灰岩變成了變質的大理石。
column5: meta 改變 + morph 形狀，像卡通角色變身後換了模樣

column2: Granite is an igneous rock, formed when molten magma cools slowly beneath the surface.
column3: 花崗岩是火成岩，由熔融岩漿在地表下慢慢冷卻形成。
column5: ig 像 ignite 點火，火變出來的岩石就是 igneous

column2: Salt is a mineral that miners dig out of ancient underground deposits.
column3: 鹽是一種礦物，礦工從古老的地下礦床中開採出來。
column5: mine 礦坑 + ral，從礦坑裡挖出來的就是 mineral

column2: Most of the sand on this beach is tiny grains of quartz worn down from mountain rock.
column3: 這片海灘的沙大多是由山岩磨碎而成的細小石英顆粒。
column4: clear quartz crystal (透明石英晶體)
column5: quartz 諧音「誇茲」，誇一誇這顆亮晶晶的水晶

column2: Pink feldspar gives this granite its color, and the mineral makes up much of Earth's crust.
column3: 粉紅色的長石讓這塊花崗岩有了顏色，這種礦物也構成地殼的大部分。
column4: pink feldspar crystals (粉紅長石晶體)
column5: feld 田野 + spar 閃亮的石頭，田野裡閃亮的岩石就是長石

column2: Thin sheets of mica peel off easily and shine like tiny mirrors inside the rock.
column3: 薄薄的雲母片很容易剝落，在岩石裡像小鏡子一樣閃閃發亮。
column5: mica 諧音「麥咖」，像一頁頁可以撕開的亮片書頁

column2: Stalactites in the cave are made of calcite left behind by dripping water.
column3: 洞穴中的鐘乳石是由滴水留下的方解石構成的。
column5: calc 石灰、鈣 + ite 礦物，含鈣的礦物就是方解石

column2: Archaeologists used carbon dating to show that the wooden tool was about nine thousand years old.
column3: 考古學家用碳定年法證明這件木製工具大約有九千年歷史。
column4: use carbon dating (使用碳定年法)
column5: carbon 碳 + dating 約會，跟古物約會，問它幾歲了

column2: Uranium has such a long half-life that billions of years pass before half of it decays.
column3: 鈾的半衰期非常長，要經過數十億年才有一半衰變掉。
column5: half 一半 + life 壽命，剩下一半所需的時間

column2: Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope of carbon with the same protons but extra neutrons.
column3: 碳14是碳的放射性同位素，質子數相同但多了中子。
column5: iso 相同 + tope 位置，在週期表上占同一個格子

column2: Without the greenhouse effect, heat would escape into space and Earth would be too cold for life.
column3: 沒有溫室效應，熱量會散逸到太空，地球會冷到無法生存。
column4: strengthen the greenhouse effect (加強溫室效應)
column5: 像溫室玻璃把熱氣關住，地球被氣體蓋上了棉被

column2: Scientists link global warming to melting glaciers and rising sea levels along low coasts.
column3: 科學家把全球暖化與冰川融化及低窪海岸的海平面上升聯繫起來。
column4: fight global warming (對抗全球暖化)
column5: global 全球 + warming 變暖，整個地球蓋了太厚的棉被

column2: Chemicals once used in refrigerators damaged the ozone layer, which blocks harmful ultraviolet light from the sun.
column3: 冰箱曾使用的化學物質破壞了臭氧層，而臭氧層能擋住太陽有害的紫外線。
column4: hole in the ozone layer (臭氧層破洞)
column5: ozone 諧音「喔鬆」，臭氧層是地球的防曬傘，破洞就要補

column2: Doctors cover your body with a lead apron to limit exposure to radiation during an X-ray.
column3: 做X光檢查時，醫生會用鉛衣蓋住你的身體，減少輻射的暴露。
column5: radi 像 radio 和 ray 射線，向四面八方放射出去

column2: Fresh snow has a high albedo, so it reflects most sunlight back into space instead of absorbing it.
column3: 新雪的反照率很高，所以會把大部分陽光反射回太空而不是吸收。
column4: high albedo surface (高反照率表面)
column5: albedo 來自拉丁文 albus 白色，越白的東西越反光

column2: In a pot of boiling soup, convection carries hot liquid upward while cooler liquid sinks.
column3: 在滾燙的湯鍋裡，對流把熱的液體往上帶，較冷的液體則下沉。
column5: 熱水往上冒、冷水往下沉，像旋轉木馬一直轉圈

column2: A metal spoon left in hot tea soon feels hot because heat travels along it by conduction.
column3: 放在熱茶裡的金屬湯匙很快變燙，是因為熱經由傳導沿著湯匙傳過來。
column5: con 一起 + duct 引導，熱沿著物體像水管一樣被送過去

column2: The summer monsoon brings heavy rain to South Asia, and rice farmers depend on it.
column3: 夏季季風為南亞帶來豪雨，種稻的農民都仰賴它。
column5: monsoon 諧音「夢筍」，大雨一下，竹筍都冒出來了

column2: Hurricane winds tore roofs off houses along the Florida coast before the storm weakened inland.
column3: 颶風的強風掀掉了佛羅里達海岸房屋的屋頂，之後才在內陸減弱。
column5: hurricane 諧音「哈利肯」，哈利用力一吹，屋頂全飛走

column2: A tornado formed beneath the dark cloud and cut a narrow path through the farmland.
column3: 一場龍捲風在烏雲下形成，在農地上劃出一條狹窄的路徑。
column5: tornado 諧音「偷那都」，龍捲風像小偷把東西全捲走

column2: Meteorologists tracked the cyclone as it spun across the Indian Ocean toward Bangladesh.
column3: 氣象學家追蹤這個氣旋橫越印度洋、朝孟加拉移動的路徑。
column5: cyc 像 cycle 腳踏車輪，一圈圈旋轉的風暴

column2: After two years of drought, the reservoir was nearly empty and farmers lost most of their crops.
column3: 連續兩年乾旱後，水庫幾乎見底，農民損失了大部分作物。
column5: drought 裡有 out，雨都 out 了，天空沒水可下

column2: Cacti thrive in arid regions where less than ten inches of rain falls each year.
column3: 仙人掌在每年降雨不到十吋的乾旱地區生長得很好。
column5: a + rid，rid 是擺脫，把水全擺脫掉就乾透了

column2: Much of the American Great Plains is semi-arid, so wheat farmers must use water carefully.
column3: 美國大平原大部分地區屬半乾旱，所以種小麥的農民必須小心用水。
column5: semi 一半，像 semicircle 半圓，再加 arid 乾旱

column2: Overgrazing and tree cutting led to desertification, turning once-green pastures into dry, sandy land.
column3: 過度放牧和砍樹造成沙漠化，使曾經翠綠的牧場變成乾燥的沙地。
column5: desert 沙漠 + ification 變成，像 purification 一樣的變化過程
column7: de - sert - i - fi - ca - tion

column2: After days of walking, the caravan reached an oasis with palm trees and a clear spring.
column3: 走了好幾天後，駝隊抵達一處有棕櫚樹和清泉的綠洲。
column5: oasis 諧音「喔唉西絲」，旅人看到水，喔～唉～鬆了口氣

column2: Wind pushed the loose sand into a tall dune that slowly crept across the road.
column3: 風把鬆散的沙子推成一座高高的沙丘，慢慢蓋過了馬路。
column5: dune 諧音「丟」，風把沙子一把一把丟成小山

column2: Through photosynthesis, leaves use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make sugar and release oxygen.
column3: 葉子透過光合作用，利用陽光、水和二氧化碳製造糖並釋出氧氣。
column4: carry out photosynthesis (進行光合作用)
column5: photo 光 + synthesis 合成，用光合成出糖

column2: Clownfish and sea anemones live in symbiosis: the fish gets protection while the anemone stays clean.
column3: 小丑魚與海葵共生：魚得到保護，海葵則保持乾淨。
column5: sym 一起 + bio 生命，大家一起生活

column2: In mutualism, bees gain nectar from flowers while the flowers gain a way to spread pollen.
column3: 在互利共生中，蜜蜂從花得到花蜜，花則得到傳播花粉的方法。
column4: a case of mutualism (互利共生的例子)
column5: mutual 彼此的 + ism，互相幫忙的好朋友關係

column2: Barnacles on a whale illustrate commensalism: they get a free ride, and the whale is neither helped nor hurt.
column3: 鯨魚身上的藤壺是片利共生的例子：藤壺免費搭便車，鯨魚既沒好處也沒傷害。
column4: a case of commensalism (片利共生的例子)
column5: com 一起 + mensa 餐桌，同桌吃飯，但只有一方佔便宜

column2: Tapeworm infection is a form of parasitism, since the worm feeds on its host and gives nothing back.
column3: 絛蟲感染屬於寄生，因為蟲吸取宿主的養分卻毫無回報。
column4: a form of parasitism (寄生的一種形式)
column5: parasite 寄生蟲 + ism，賴在別人身上白吃白住的關係

column2: The stick insect's camouflage is so good that it looks exactly like a twig on the branch.
column3: 竹節蟲的偽裝太完美，看起來和樹枝上的小枝一模一樣。
column4: use camouflage to hide (利用偽裝躲藏)
column5: camo 是迷彩服，穿上就和葉子混在一起，看不見你
